consumer: game::npc_menu, reached when the avatar bumps an NPC tile: it builds a uilist (Talk/Swap positions/Push away/attack/steal/...) and calls amenu.query() to ask the player which interaction to perform.
scope: the single bumped friendly NPC's interaction menu — one interactive query, not a planar move or world state region.
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu — its body constructs an interactive uilist of mutually-exclusive NPC interactions and calls amenu.query(), so the outcome is determined by an answered menu, not a silent move resolution.
divergence: Avatar bumps a friendly NPC while the player intended 'Push away' or 'Steal'; a wrong (class-A move/auto-swap) answer silently swaps positions or no-ops, discarding the chosen interaction the menu would have surfaced.
